answer: Each agent bonds collateral to a Semaphore identity and evaluates its committed epoch polynomial at a message-derived point, producing a zero-knowledge RLN proof and share. Two messages reusing the same epoch nullifier expose enough Shamir shares to reconstruct the agent’s private rate-limit key, proving duplication without revealing honest identities.
